_doc: OGRL-20261007-011/012. run38 continued with ONE change: every training fight at difficulty 1.0 (--d-min 1.0 --d-max-start 1.0). Everything else is run38's setup (same maps, learner, floors, seed). Why: run38's launcher copied --d-min 0.0 (undoing the 2026-09-09 decision) and its difficulty gate starved at 0.95, so run38 never trained at 1.0 -- the difficulty of the benchmark and of a human. Forks from a frozen copy of run38's checkpoint (run38_d1_seed.pt); run38 itself can be resumed unchanged.
purpose: OGRL-20261007-012 run38_d1: run38 continued at difficulty 1.0 only
